name: cicord-js
description: JavaScript side of Cicord: plugin SDK, runtime API client, React bindings, UI kit and the reference community portal.

scripts.test: vp run -r build && vp run -r test && vp test
scripts.check: vp run -r build && vp check && vp run -r typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:examples
scripts.typecheck:examples: tsc -p examples/basic/plugins/welcome && tsc -p examples/basic/plugins/onboarding && tsc -p examples/basic/plugins/onboarding/test && tsc -p examples/showcase/plugins/tickets && tsc -p examples/showcase/plugins/tickets/test && tsc -p examples/showcase/plugins/polls && tsc -p examples/showcase/plugins/polls/test && tsc -p examples/showcase/plugins/levels && tsc -p examples/showcase/plugins/levels/test && tsc -p examples/showcase/plugins/moderation && tsc -p examples/showcase/plugins/moderation/test && tsc -p examples/showcase/plugins/reaction-roles && tsc -p examples/showcase/plugins/reaction-roles/test && tsc -p examples/showcase/plugins/audit-log && tsc -p examples/showcase/plugins/audit-log/test && tsc -p examples/showcase/plugins/announcements && tsc -p examples/showcase/plugins/announcements/test
scripts.dev:portal: vp run -t create-cicord-portal#build && vp run create-cicord-portal#dev
